stem: A hose and harvest cart block part of the designated aisle before movement begins. What should Technician I do?
choices: Apply the allowed routine control to restore the aisle and verify the path is clear before cart movement begins.
Work around the hose and cart as long as the team is warned about the obstruction.
Move the harvest cart quickly through the narrowed aisle to reduce the time workers are exposed.
Leave the obstruction in place because the harvest schedule has already started.
rationale: A blocked aisle creates a foreseeable movement and trip hazard before harvest traffic begins. Technician I should correct the routine obstruction within authority and verify the pathway is clear rather than relying on awareness or speed. The schedule does not override a basic safe-work condition.
